scenes.text: Elon Musk's fortune dropped sixty-eight billion in one month. That's twenty-five thousand dollars a second.
GTA 6 on day one: forty-three thousand dollars every second.
The US debt in the last year: seventy-six thousand dollars a second.
And the winner... Cyber Monday shoppers. A hundred sixty-four thousand dollars a second!
Shoppers beat billionaires. Follow for more money facts.

title: Who Makes the Most Money Per Second?
